svg.text: A. A graph, and what a browser fetches to show chr1:12-18
Blue nodes are chr1. s5 is an HG002 allele that replaces s3.
one bar per line of graph.segs.bed.gz, at the interval Tabix searches
the node query returned its line
drawn where a link line puts it
B. The files gfa-to-tabix writes, and the lines the two queries return

svg.text: Rank 0 is chr1. s5 is not on chr1, so its line gets chr1:10-40,
from the start of s2 to the end of s4, the nodes it connects to.

svg.text: A link line's interval covers its nodes, their neighbours on chr1 and any allele off them.
The link lines give the positions of s1, s3 and s4, so the browser draws the bubble whole;
the reference allele, s3, comes back only this way.
